user.title: Add WeCom app
user.description: Create an internal app in the WeCom admin console and paste its credentials here. The sending host's public IP must be listed under the app's trusted IPs.

data_description.corpid: Corp ID of your enterprise, found under My Company > Company Info in the WeCom admin console.
data_description.agentid: AgentId of the internal app, found on the app detail page.
data_description.secret: Secret of the internal app. Used to obtain an access token.
data_description.touser: Default recipients, separated by |, for example @all or user1|user2. Use @all for everyone in the app's visible range.
data_description.api_base: Leave empty to use the official WeCom API. Only change it for a self-hosted gateway or local testing.
data_description.touser_self: Your own WeCom member account (UserID, visible in Contacts). When set, an extra notify entity with a "personal" suffix is created that sends only to you; leave empty to skip.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WeCom app
reconfigure.description: Update the credentials or recipients. The integration reloads after you submit.

data_description.touser: Default recipients, separated by |, for example @all.
data_description.api_base: Leave empty to use the official WeCom API. Only change it for a self-hosted gateway or local testing.
data_description.touser_self: Your own WeCom member account (UserID, visible in Contacts). When set, an extra notify entity with a "personal" suffix is created that sends only to you; leave empty to skip.

error.invalid_auth: WeCom rejected the credentials. Check the Corp ID, Agent ID, secret, and whether the sending IP is trusted.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the WeCom API. Check the network and the API base URL.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This WeCom app is already configured.

send_rich.name: Send rich message
send_rich.description: Push a text, textcard, news or markdown message to the WeCom app.

message.name: Message
message.description: Message body. For text messages the title is prefixed with a divider.

title.name: Title
title.description: Required for textcard and news; used as a prefix for text messages.

url.name: URL
url.description: Link opened when the message is tapped.

touser.name: Recipients
touser.description: Overrides the default recipients for this message.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Push only through the selected WeCom app. Leave empty to push through all configured apps.
